MessDatabase.title: MessDatabase
MessDatabase.description: Primary ledger state containing all expenses, contributions, months, and settings for the mess.

months.description: List of active and finalized billing months

expenses.description: All recorded mess expenses with split calculation data

contributions.description: All recorded deposits and member balance contributions

auditLogs.description: Audit logs recording operations and actions

settings.description: Mess details, currency symbol, and authentication settings

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the latest change

/mess_records/{recordId}.description: Stores the central live synchronized ledger data for the mess.
